newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Sept 23.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Indonesian political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Jakarta. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (6221) 384-6364. Fax: (6221) 344-8404.
Authorities arrested 24 men and 10 women in Bandung for use of the drug Ecstasy. Indonesia is in the process of tightening up its laws on the use of the drug.

President Suharto is set to go to Malaysia for talks over the disputed Sipadan and Ligitan islands. Indonesian military chief General Feisal Tanjung said that Indonesia prefers a peaceful settlement to the long-running dispute.

State-owned Bank Indonesia Negara today begins its "roadshow" in Indonesian cities to promote planned privatisation later this year. An initial public offering is expected sometime in November. The bank announced on Friday that it had already filed a registration statement with the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) for an initial public offering.
Bozwell Worldwide, a major American advertising firm, plans toset up a joint venture next year with PT Dian Mentari Pratama.
A merger between Bank Tiara and Bank Mashill is only a matter of time, said a director of Bank Tiara.
